Signature Advisory

By application only  ·  Limited availability

A strategic and financial partnership for founders and executives who have outgrown ordinary advisory relationships.

By application only

Every client personally vetted

Fewer clients. Deeper work

Selective by design

Direct, on-demand support

Whenever you need it

Most advisory relationships are reactive. You get a report when you ask for one. A call when you schedule it. Advice that stops at the edge of the advisor’s comfort zone.

Signature Advisory is built differently.

What this is

A different kind of engagement.

Signature Advisory is a high-touch, long-term strategic and financial partnership. Not a retainer with monthly check-ins. A relationship where your strategic partner is embedded in your most important decisions.

She brings the perspective of someone who has built, scaled, and advised businesses across multiple industries and jurisdictions. She is a founder herself. She understands what it costs to get it wrong, and what it takes to get it right.

Engagements are structured entirely around your goals. Scope, cadence, and deliverables are designed specifically for you.

Apply Now

WHO THIS IS FOR

The right fit

  • You are scaling past the point where general advice applies
  • You are navigating acquisition, restructuring, or rapid expansion
  • You need someone fluent in both financial and strategic dimensions
  • You have outgrown your current advisory relationships
  • You want a thinking partner, not a report writer

Not a fit

  • You want a one-time project or deliverable
  • You are not ready to act on what you learn
  • You want validation more than honest perspective
  • You are early-stage and still testing your core model

What changes

Results that compound.

Financial
clarity

You know your numbers. Not just what they are, but what they mean and what to do next.

Strategic
confidence

You stop second-guessing major decisions. You have a sounding board who has been in the situation before.

Operational alignment

Your financial architecture supports your business model, not the other way around.

Deal
readiness

Whether buying, selling, raising, or restructuring, you move from a position of strength.

A partner
in the room

Before a critical meeting, negotiation, or commitment, you have a trusted voice.

Compounding perspective

The longer we work together, the more valuable the relationship becomes. Context compounds.

Access to a
curated network

When a challenge calls for a specialist, we do not send you to Google. We make introductions.

About Your Partner

Lisa Shelley

Ten years in financial and strategic advisory.

Thirteen years building and operating businesses across multiple industries.

Lisa Shelley brings something most advisors cannot: she has been on both sides of the table.

She leads the Client Advisory Services practice at Abacus, one of Bermuda’s leading accounting and advisory firms, while operating multiple businesses spanning wholesale, e-commerce, and consulting.

Her clients range from independent operators to growing enterprises navigating acquisitions, restructuring, and expansion across virtually every industry.

No subcontractors.

The process

Four steps.

Step 01

Apply

Tell us where you are and where you would like to be.

Step 02

Conversation

A direct conversation. No pitch deck, no sales process.

Step 03

Mutual decision

We decide together whether this is the right fit.

Step 04

Engagement

We design our engagement around your specific situation.

Apply Now

Applications reviewed quarterly

You already know if this is for you.

Apply Now

Investment From   $5,000 / month

Questions

Common questions.

Is this the same as your accounting or advisory services?
No. Signature Advisory is a separate, premium engagement. If you need bookkeeping or accounting, that is handled through our Accounting and Bookkeeping service. If you need strategic support without the full Signature commitment, our Advisory service may be the right starting point.
What industries do you work with?
Virtually all of them. Lisa has advised businesses across retail, hospitality, professional services, real estate, e-commerce, and beyond. Strategic and financial advisory is largely industry-agnostic at its core.
How long does an engagement last?
Engagements require a minimum six-month commitment. This is not a project or a trial — it is a relationship, and relationships take time to deliver compounding value. Most clients continue well beyond the initial term.
What does it cost?
Signature Advisory starts at $5,000 per month. The exact structure is discussed directly and built around the scope of your engagement.
What if I am not accepted?
If Signature Advisory is not the right fit, we will say so directly. In many cases, our Advisory service is the right starting point, and we will tell you that.
Apply for Signature Advisory

Starting from $5,000 / month  ·  Minimum six months
